scripts.build:all: bun run db:fetch && bun run pages:build
scripts.pages:deploy: aws s3 sync ./dist/pages s3://pages --endpoint-url https://8a48bde066e009089f9f8e944792d619.r2.cloudflarestorage.com --content-type "text/html; charset=utf-8" --profile r2
scripts.disable-remote: npx wrangler d1 execute db --remote --command="UPDATE segments SET status = 'private';"
scripts.enable-remote: npx wrangler d1 execute db --remote --command="UPDATE segments SET status = 'public';"
scripts.db:reset: rm -rf .wrangler/state/v3/d1 && bunx wrangler d1 execute DB --local --file=./schema.sql && bunx wrangler d1 execute DB --local --file=./seed.sql
